subject: MSA / Order Form + Ariba/Coupa onboarding — Starlite Health integration
messages:
From: Emily Ramos <emily.ramos@starlitehealth.com>
To: jordan_blake@redwood.com
Cc: procurement_ops@starlitehealth.com
Date: Tue, 09 Mar 2027 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood onboarding — MSA and portal fields (Ariba preferred)

Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement at Starlite would like to start the vendor onboarding for Redwood. Two immediate asks so we can kick off our portal registration: 1) a redline of the MSA showing any material changes you request (we prefer to keep liability limits standard), and 2) a spreadsheet of required PO/invoice fields for Ariba (we can fall back to Coupa if needed).

We have our procurement team copied (procurement_ops@starlitehealth.com) and will run this through Ariba. Important notes from our side: PO number prefix must be SLT-, invoices should include the remit address and tax id, and vendor must ACK POs within 24 hours.

Attached: Starlite_MSA_v3_for_review.pdf (their draft), sample PO export from Ariba.

Can Redwood provide a redline + an order form template compatible with Ariba? Ideally we can have the redline and mapping by EOD Wednesday, Mar 10 so we can start portal provisioning.

Regards,
Emily Ramos
Sr. Vendor Manager, Starlite Health
v: 415-555-0123

Attachments: Starlite_MSA_v3_for_review.pdf (pdf, 1.2MB), Ariba_PO_Export_sample.csv (csv)
From: jordan_blake@redwood.com
To: Emily Ramos <emily.ramos@starlitehealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 09 Mar 2027 09:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding — MSA and portal fields (Ariba preferred)

Emily —

Thanks — looping in Marissa (ops) and Kimberly (legal) to own the redline and portal mapping. High-level plan:
- Legal (Kimberly) will produce a redline of the MSA and call out any commercial asks.
- Ops (Marissa + Markus) will map Redwood's order form fields to the Ariba CSV and confirm PO ACK behavior and test environment.
- I'll coordinate timelines with your procurement team and share a mutual action plan.

Quick Q: do you require us to register as a supplier in your Ariba test tenant first, or can we hand off documentation for your onboarding team to create the supplier and send us the Supplier ID?

We aim to have the redline + order form mapping to you by end of day tomorrow (Mar 10).

—Jordan
Director, Partner Ops | Redwood Inference

Attachments: —
From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: Emily Ramos <emily.ramos@starlitehealth.com>
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 09 Mar 2027 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding — MSA and portal fields (Ariba preferred)

Emily / Jordan —

Attached is Redwood's redline (Starlite_MSA_redline_v3.pdf). Summary of material items we flagged:
1) Data handling & retention — proposed a 90-day cache retention exception for inference logs tied to debugging and abuse detection; customer data sovereignty requirements honored on Private deployments.
2) Indemnity — propose mutual indemnity limited to proven direct damages; carve-outs for gross negligence and willful misconduct.
3) Liability cap — we requested a cap tied to the total fees paid in the preceding 12 months, with consideration for higher caps in Dedicated/Private deals.
4) Order form clarity — we added an exhibit listing required PO fields and specified currency and tax handling.

Open asks for procurement mapping: can you confirm the required XML/CSV header names Ariba will send for PO number, line-level item code, unit_price, tax_amount, remit_address, and the supplier identifier your system will create? We included an initial mapping in the attached OrderForm_PO-specs.xlsx.

We redlined conservatively — willing to discuss specific clauses on a call.

Attachments: Starlite_MSA_redline_v3.pdf (pdf, 470KB), OrderForm_PO-specs.xlsx (xlsx, 28KB)

Cc: procurement_ops@starlitehealth.com, VendorOnboarding <onboard@starlitehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 07:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding — MSA and portal fields (Ariba preferred)

Thanks, Kimberly — appreciate the clear summary. A few clarifications from procurement: 
- Ariba will send the PO export headers exactly as: PO_NUMBER, LINE_NUMBER, ITEM_ID, DESCRIPTION, QUANTITY, UNIT_PRICE, TAX_AMOUNT, CURRENCY, REMIT_ADDRESS, SUPPLIER_ID.
- Supplier ID: if Redwood can register in our Ariba test tenant we will return a SUPPLIER_ID; otherwise our onboarding team will create one and share it.
- PO prefix is mandatory for our downstream ERP — it will be SLT- (example: SLT-20270309-001).
- We require W9 or W-8BEN (depending on tax status) and proof of insurance (certificate) before supplier activation.

I attached our Ariba field export and the PO-spec worksheet. Proposed timeline: supplier creation + documentation upload by Mar 15; live in Production tenant by Mar 22, contingent on legal signoff.

Attachments: Ariba-Supplier-Fields.csv (csv, 4KB), PO-specs_Starlite.xlsx (xlsx, 24KB)

Regards,
Emily Ramos
Sr. Vendor Manager, Starlite Health
From: jordan_blake@redwood.com
To: Emily Ramos <emily.ramos@starlitehealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 11:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding — MSA and portal fields (Ariba preferred)

Emily / Starlite team —

Thanks for the quick turn. Internal summary and next steps:
- Legal: Kimberly to review your requested final language and revert with track-change acceptance or narrow counter-proposals by EOD Mar 12. (If liability cap needs escalation, Jordan will seek approval.)
- Operations: Marissa + Markus to map Redwood's order-form fields to your Ariba headers and confirm PO ACK process; we will test with your Ariba test tenant if you can create the supplier there (preferred).
- Tax & Compliance: Soojin will gather W9 and certificate of insurance; ETA Mar 15.
- Mutual Action Plan: Target supplier creation in test tenant Mar 15 -> promote to Prod Mar 22 after signoff.

Proposed quick sync: Thu, Mar 11 10:00 AM PT — 30 min — to resolve open redline items and confirm test workflow. Emily, can you send a calendar invite with dial-in?

Attachments: Ariba-Supplier-Fields.csv, OrderForm_PO-specs.xlsx, Starlite_MSA_redline_v3.pdf (for reference)

Thanks — Jordan
Director, Partner Ops | Redwood Inference
